text:
Maya: Heads-up — we're scheduling a scoped penetration test against payment-microservices next Tue 09:00-12:00 PT. Scope is auth flow, order-processing, and the billing worker. Need to confirm RBAC windows, KMS access surface, and audit-log snapshot/export. Vendor asked for presigned S3 links for log ingestion. Who can own ephemeral role rotation + evidence packaging?

Vik: I can own ephemeral roles. We should not expose key material — we'll provide a kms-proxy with read-only ops. Allowed KMS calls: DescribeKey, ListAliases, GetKeyRotationStatus. No Decrypt/GenerateDataKey. For S3, prefix = pen-tests/payment-microservices/<ts>/, pre-signed TTL = 24h.

Sam: Oncall availability: I can cover 09:00-11:00 PT that day. Will need a small runbook for rapid rollback & alerting hooks. Put me as the escalation contact for infra.

Lina: Staging safety note — freeze deploys for the window + 2 hours buffer (start 07:00 PT -> end 14:00 PT) to avoid flapping. Also want a snapshot of audit logs (CloudTrail + app logs) exported to security S3 with integrity hash. Is 90-day retention for the snapshot OK?

Maya: 90 days for the snapshot is fine. For the ephemeral role workflow: we'll provision an STS role with external-id and TTL=2h, rotated via HashiCorp Vault. Minimal IAM example for the role (workshop snippet):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "kms:DescribeKey",
        "kms:ListAliases",
        "kms:GetKeyRotationStatus",
        "s3:PutObject",
        "s3:PutObjectAcl",
        "s3:GetObject"
      ],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/EXAMPLE", "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pen-tests/*"]
    }
  ]
}
```
Notes: no Decrypt/Encrypt, no GetObjectAcl except for ingestion checks.

Vik: Couple more technicals:
- KMS proxy will log requests to security-traces (separate bucket). Ensure CloudTrail is enabled for KMS and STS.
- We'll create a read-only KMS IAM role in the account and a cross-account role for the vendor with `sts:AssumeRole` + external-id.
- Provide vendor only metadata endpoints (DescribeKey), and a sandboxed service account for API calls.

Maya: Vendor onboarding checklist (short):
- Signed NDA + AUP uploaded to SEC-PT-2283 ticket
- External-id and role ARN provided to vendor
- Presigned S3 link template and prefix
- Snapshot export ran and MD5/SHA256 attached
- Oncall + infra contact in ticket

Sam: I'll make a tiny runbook gist and attach to the ticket. Also confirm: who owns the retest slots if vendor finds issues?

Lina: Product-security will triage vulnerabilities and assign to squads. We prefer a 2-week initial remediation SLA for critical issues found in-scope. For retest: vendor can request 2 2-hour slots within 30 days; we schedule during low-traffic window.

Maya: Perfect. I'll open SEC-PT-2283 and attach the runbook + IAM snippet. Vendor contact: pen-test@vendorco.example. Please react with :thumbsup: once you've reviewed your ownership items.

deploy-bot: smoke-tests scheduled for pre-window at 07:15 PT — will post results to the ticket.

Vik: :thumbsup: I'll add the CloudTrail exports and create the presigned link job.

Sam: :thumbsup: Runbook coming in 15m.

Lina: :thumbsup: I'll draft the triage play and SLA text in the ticket.

Maya: Thanks all — tagging follow-ups in SEC-PT-2283.
